name: Curtin Guild Emergency Hardship Grant
summary: Case-by-case vouchers, gift cards or bill payments for low-income onshore Curtin students facing unexpected hardship.
who: Currently enrolled, onshore Curtin student, domestic or international
Low income, such as receiving or meeting the requirements of a means-tested Centrelink payment
Unexpected circumstances causing significant financial hardship
how: Request an appointment with Guild Student Assist and bring enrolment confirmation, bank statements and income records
catches: Grant approval and the amount disbursed is on a case-by-case basis

source.label: Curtin Student Guild: Emergency Hardship Grant

evidence.quote: Grant approval and the amount disbursed is on a case-by-case basis.
